# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Pre-Summer Preventive Maintenance Schedule

**Generated by: Housekeeping & Maintenance skill**
**Window:** May 12 – Jun 15, 2026 (5 weeks before peak summer)
**Coordinator:** Diego Alvarez
**Total properties:** 24 (8 condos, 12 cabins, 4 lakefront)

---

## Goals for This PM Cycle

1. Every property has working HVAC tested under summer load by Jun 1.
2. Every cabin and lakefront property has a deck pressure-wash before Memorial Day weekend (May 23).
3. Every grill has a verified propane tank + working igniter by May 18.
4. Every smart-lock battery checked; mesh Wi-Fi verified at every property.
5. Every hot tub on Sundance firmware patch (carrying over from Apr 30 issue).
6. Every lakefront has docks, beach gear, and life jackets confirmed before lake-season opens (May 23).

## PM Task Checklist (per property)

Every property in the cycle gets these standard items:

- [ ] HVAC service: filter swap, condensate line cleared, blower test, thermostat calibration
- [ ] Smoke detector battery test (replace if >12 months old)
- [ ] CO detector battery test
- [ ] Fire extinguisher inspection (gauge in green, no rust)
- [ ] Smart-lock battery test (replace if <50%)
- [ ] Wi-Fi router restart + speed test (>100 Mbps verified at every spot)
- [ ] Mattress flip (queen + king beds)
- [ ] Pillow audit (replace any flat or yellow pillow)
- [ ] Linen par check (rotation 3x — confirmed in inventory)
- [ ] Towel par check (3x rotation)
- [ ] Trash bin condition (replace if cracked)
- [ ] Bear enclosure latch (Old Town + cabin properties)
- [ ] Outdoor grill: propane tank %, igniter test, brush off grates
- [ ] Outdoor furniture: tighten bolts, replace cushions if faded
- [ ] Hot tub: chemicals balanced, cover seal good, jets functional, firmware patched
- [ ] Welcome amenity inventory (welcome card, snack, water, branded sticker pack)

### Cabin/lakefront extras

- [ ] Firepit / wood pile / lighters
- [ ] Deck pressure-wash (every 24 months minimum)
- [ ] Patio furniture cushions inspected
- [ ] Hammock / outdoor seating tested

### Lakefront extras

- [ ] Dock inspected (no rotted boards, cleats tight)
- [ ] Boat slip electrical (GFCI test)
- [ ] Life jackets: count, no torn straps, sized for kids/adults
- [ ] Paddleboards / kayaks inflated, paddles, leashes
- [ ] Beach gear closet inventory (chairs, umbrellas, sand toys)
- [ ] Dock keys present + tested

### Old Town extras

- [ ] HOA-compliance walk: no exterior storage, parking signs visible
- [ ] Quiet hours signage (interior + exterior plaques)
